e: Option D (M&P (and other capital assets) to spread cost over useful life) is the correct choice. This is the fact laid down for the situation described in the question. A useful way to verify this in the exam hall is to ask what would break if the opposite were true — the logic of the underlying system points straight to this option. Eliminate the distractors by checking each against the question's exact wording; only one option matches the definition precisely. Learn the meaning rather than the option letter; examiners frequently reword this concept with shuffled choices.
